title: Bound review document loading and page review threads and comments
outcome: Review detail and update replies do not load or return arbitrarily large merged documents; summary remains inexpensive.
acceptance: Review file reads and validation enforce a documented byte/record policy before whole-document allocation, and thread/comment bodies use bounded projections or retrieval pages.

GET review and PUT result preserve all stored comments and merge semantics with explicit completeness; summary obtains bounded summary metadata or bounded processing rather than an unbounded full-file read.
No silent loss, truncation or rewriting of existing reviews; over-limit cases have typed recoverable behavior through existing review owner.
Tests cover repeated merges, externally large files and escaped comment bodies with small limits; independent review and full gate pass.
